findings.title: Command injection in os.system call
findings.explanation: String concatenation is used to construct a shell command executed by os.system without sanitization. If 'path' or 'dest' contains shell metacharacters, arbitrary system commands can be executed.
findings.suggestion: Use the subprocess module without a shell, passing arguments as a list: subprocess.run(['tar', '-czf', dest, path], check=True), or use the built-in 'tarfile' library.
